description: CETD, a global compound events detection and visualisation toolbox and dataset is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Cong Yin et al. Compound events (CEs) are attracting increased attention due to their significant societal and ecological impacts. However, their complexity can make CEs difficult to detect and visualise for climate scientists and practitioners. Coverage: global; published in 2025. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 81326238657 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
